name: Mohamed Arslan — WF-02 Validate Content Package

parameters.query: SELECT job_id, site_key, operation, status, drive_folder_id, manifest_file_id, target_languages, iframe_allowlist FROM content_jobs LEFT JOIN site_configs USING (site_key) WHERE job_id = $1 LIMIT 1;

UPDATE content_jobs
SET status = 'VALIDATING', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE job_id = $1 AND status IN ('CREATED','VALIDATION_FAILED')
RETURNING job_id, status;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$("15 Compile Validation Result").item.json.jobId, $("15 Compile Validation Result").item.json.status, ($("15 Compile Validation Result").item.json.passed ? null : JSON.stringify($("15 Compile Validation Result").item.json.errors)) ] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO job_events (job_id, event_type, workflow_name, execution_id, payload)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$("15 Compile Validation Result").item.json.jobId, $("15 Compile Validation Result").item.json.status, "Mohamed Arslan — WF-02 Validate Content Package", $execution.id, JSON.stringify({ passed: $("15 Compile Validation Result").item.json.passed, errorCount: $("15 Compile Validation Result").item.json.errors.length }) ] }}

parameters.content:
WF-02 Validate Content Package
Status gate (CREATED|VALIDATION_FAILED) → conditional UPDATE lock → VALIDATING → load manifest + per-language content.json → field/placeholder/media/script/iframe checks → slug check (MOCK API) → write validation-report.json to 07-reports → set CONTENT_READY / VALIDATION_FAILED.

IMPORTANT: the current content loader is a DEVELOPMENT MOCK. Connect Google Drive and replace the mock loader with real per-language JSON downloads before Production.

MOCK: "14 Slug Check (Mock API)" points at https://mock.wisal.local/... Replace with the real Custom Website API check-slug endpoint once available.
Errors → 99 Build Error Response (JOB_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_STATE, VALIDATION_LOCKED). Content errors → 20 Build Response with VALIDATION_FAILED + per-error {code, language, path}.

IMPORTANT: the current content loader is a DEVELOPMENT MOCK. Connect Google Drive and replace the mock loader with real per-language JSON downloads before Production.
